description.value: Storm City Coffee is a scratch-made, health-conscious neighbourhood café that has anchored Kitsilano since 2017, run by owners Sara and Assad with a philosophy of organic ingredients, 100% extra-virgin olive oil, and locally roasted espresso. The full menu spans all-day brunch, house-baked pastries, pressed organic juices, and a wide range of espresso drinks, all made from scratch each morning. The café doubles as a genuine community hub—hosting art workshops, silent book clubs, and free community gatherings, with wall space consigned to local artists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active Kitsilano café at 3403 W Broadway with a rich menu, 2026 events, and consistent branding. The events-page footer lists the phone as (236) 484-3444, which differs from the OSM tag +1-604-428-9585; per rule 12 the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the site; takeout is confirmed via the Uber Eats delivery callout, and vegetarian-suitable options are evident from the menu (avo toasts, healthy bowls, smoothies, pressed organic juices).
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-428-9585 but the website events-page footer shows (236) 484-3444; website value used.
About page inconsistency: page title says 'Since 2017' but the body text says 'Since 2019'.
Art Workshop event listing shows the venue address as '130 W Broadway, Vancouver' rather than the main address 3403 W Broadway — likely a data-entry error in the third-party event registration.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café with a live website, events listed into 2026, and an OSM check date of 2025-05-23 showing no closure concerns.
